environment.build: Release opt-level=3, fat LTO, codegen-units=1, panic=abort; default Intl
environment.background: Desktop applications active; no owned build/test/profile overlapped timing or peak comparisons.

scope: Closed synchronous same-realm numeric own-data record getters with complete body and live descriptor proofs, normal callbacks on every observer/resource guard miss.

candidate_source.head: bec5e4a530c4e786264a7329d9801c32202b44a3
candidate_source.note: Closed synchronous same-realm numeric own-data record getters; bounded structural Chunk plan, live field IC/descriptor guards, exact callback fallbacks at observers/resource boundaries. Reject unsupported getter bodies before resource/receiver checks.

timing_analysis.method: Paired log-ratio Student-t interval; four balanced fresh-process pairs. Node is a single reference observation.

peak_memory.method: Linux os.wait4 ru_maxrss in KiB; four fresh balanced pairs per workload, separate from application timings. No post-GC retained-memory claim.

peak_analysis.method: Four balanced pairs; Student-t 95% interval on paired log peak ratios.

validation.scope_limits: No fresh workspace-wide, Test262, x64/wasm or optional-backend execution. JS fixtures exercise ordinary tiers on ARM64.

initial_attempt.finding: Solver median 2.53% lower; Vue median 1.94% higher, interval excludes parity. Reworked to reject unsupported bodies before receiver/resource checks.

decision: Retain revised solver median 2.16% benefit, interval excludes parity. Vue median +1.14% and Djot user CPU +1.73% also exclude parity but are below 3% combined gates. Peak intervals include parity. No broad engine gain or Node parity claim.
artifact_promotion: No installed or accepted binary replaced.

provenance_correction.reason: An inherited inventory field retained the earlier prototype patch hash. Corrected from the preserved exact source.patch, already recorded correctly under evidence_hashes. Raw snapshots, source file hashes, binary identities and observations are unchanged.
